::: {style="font-size: 120%;"}
Welcome to my University of Chicago page!

I am a Senior Instructional Professor in the Department of Computer Science, where I [teach](teaching.qmd) intro CS, software development, and computer networks.

I am involved in a number of [other activities](other.qmd) on campus, such as being the faculty advisor to the department's student organizations.

I am not actively involved in research at the moment, but my [research](research.qmd) has primarily focused on resource allocation on distributed systems using virtualization. I have [published](publications.qmd) a number of papers on those subjects and, more recently, I have also published some papers on Computer Science Education.

I also design [t-shirts](tshirts.qmd) and enjoy cooking Spanish food (check out my recipes at [Borja's Tasty Bytes](https://borja.recipes/)).
:::
